answer: Audits are logged in sparrow, queued in horizon, and copper publishes the wait time. A farm of 68 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 14 identities per epoch. A farm of 1455 identities would post 3459 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
